pages.text: A Polar Crystal grows on any face of a block, be it floor, wall or ceiling. Any spell that strikes it, whether a bolt, a fireball or a beam, flips it between its dark and its glowing blue state.

While glowing, the crystal gives a full redstone signal to the block it grows on, and that block passes the signal on: mechanisms up to three blocks away from the crystal react to it. Strike it again to switch it off. Beams count as a single strike while they stay on the crystal.
